description.zh: 连接 Legado，在严格已读边界内陪聊、吐槽剧情、回顾前文，并维护章节摘要、人物事件索引和读者记忆。
description.en: Connects to Legado for spoiler-safe conversation, plot reactions, recall, chapter knowledge, and reader memories.

description.zh: 读取当前进度、回顾已读剧情、生成摘要、查询人物并保存读者笔记或预测。
description.en: Reads current progress, recalls read plot, builds summaries, finds characters, and stores reader notes or predictions.

description.zh: 由用户为每本书选择一个角色卡，隔离读取下一章及有限前情，一次生成少而精的角色化段评；前情上限为最近 8 章、4.8 万字并按所选模型窗口裁剪，Legado 将角色卡名字显示为段评作者。开启会产生模型 Token 消耗。
description.en: Uses a selected per-book character card, the next chapter, and bounded private context to write sparse in-character comments. Prior context is capped at 8 chapters / 48,000 characters and trimmed to the selected model window. Legado shows the card name as author; enabling spends model tokens.
